text:
Dear all,

What would you do? During the recent war with Iran, in February and March this year, I was due to have an appointment to renew my visa. However, the visa office in **Tel Aviv** was closed, so I received an **automatic extension until 7 July 2026**. After the war, I applied for a **new appointment** directly via the application form, but never received a reply. I also sent them an email, but did not get a reply to that either. Has anyone else had the same experience? My employer is now asking about my visa... I have been in Israel for many years, I am **married**, I have had an **A5 visa** for over three years and I would actually like to apply for **citizenship** now. **But first of all, it is urgent that my visa is renewed... **What do you think?

Thank you very, very much! ❤
